title: A Crow Keeps Saying My Name (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine a crow sits on your fence every morning.
You start feeding it bits of toast. It's kind of your buddy now.
One morning, it tilts its head and says, "Hello."
You nearly drop your toast. A talking crow! You film it for your friends.
Nobody believes you. Crows can copy words, they say.
The next day, it says your name. Clear as anything.
The day after, it says, "Don't go to school today."
You go anyway. School is school.
On the way, the crow follows you. Fence to fence. Lamp post to lamp post.
At the crossing, it lands right in front of you and screams your name.
You stop. A truck flies through the red light, right where you would've been.
You look at the crow. It looks at you.
That night, it taps on your bedroom window.
*It says, very quietly, in your dad's voice, "Let me in. It's cold."
And your dad has been gone for three years.
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
